top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 arc from proglucagon processing and the insulinotropic action of GLP-1(7-36) through receptor biology to agonists with randomized outcome evidence is original, independently confirmed, mature and clinically very large. The prize rewards the discovery of a principle, and identification of the active truncated peptide is the step on which both the human physiology and the later pharmacology depend, so Drucker, Holst and Mojsov give the citation most traceable in the primary literature. Mojsov's priority against the Habener group is the weak point, but P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a close second and far better than no award.
